cards.ex: I'm looking forward to the weekend.
I'm on my way now. See you soon!
Do you want to grab a bite before the movie?
Let me sleep on it and tell you tomorrow.

quiz.q: I'm really looking forward ___ you again.
quiz.note: look forward to 뒤에는 -ing! 한국인이 가장 많이 틀리는 포인트예요.

quiz.q: Don't worry, I'm ___ now. Five minutes!
quiz.note: in my way는 '내 길을 막고 있다'라 뜻이 완전히 달라져요.

quiz.q: I'm hungry. Let's ___ before the meeting.
quiz.note: grab a bite = 간단히 요기하다. grab이 핵심!

quiz.q: It's a big decision. Why don't you ___ ?
quiz.note: sleep on it — 순서 주의! it이 뒤에 옵니다.

cards.ex: I'll keep you posted on the schedule.

cards.expr: off the top of my head
cards.ex: Off the top of my head, I'd say around fifty.
It's already 7. Let's call it a day.
We can't cut corners on safety.
Please keep me in the loop about the project.

quiz.note: keep someone posted = 소식 생기면 계속 알려주다.

quiz.q: ___ , I can't remember the exact number.
options: Off the top of my head
quiz.note: off the top of my head = 자료 없이 즉석에서.

quiz.q: We've done enough for today. Let's ___ .
quiz.note: 끝낼 때 쓰는 정해진 표현이라 단어를 바꾸면 어색해요.

quiz.q: The result was bad because they ___ during testing.
quiz.note: corner를 잘라 지름길로 간다는 이미지에서 온 표현.

quiz.q: I'm new to this project, so please keep me ___ .
quiz.note: loop = 정보가 도는 고리. in the loop = 그 안에 있다.

cards.ex: If you read between the lines, he's not happy.
She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
He got cold feet right before the presentation.
That name rings a bell, but I can't place it.
I hate dentists, but I'll bite the bullet and go.

quiz.q: His email sounds polite, but ___ — he's actually upset.
quiz.hint: 겉으로 드러나지 않은 뜻을 파악하라고 할 때
quiz.note: 줄과 줄 사이(between the lines)에 숨은 의미가 있다는 이미지예요.

quiz.q: Our team always ___ to make customers happy.
quiz.hint: 기대보다 한 걸음 더 애쓴다는 표현 (3인칭 주의)
quiz.note: our team은 단수 취급 — goes! 1마일을 더 간다는 이미지.

quiz.q: She was going to quit her job, but she ___ at the last minute.
quiz.note: 발이 차가워져 얼어붙는 이미지. 결혼·발표·퇴사 앞에서 자주 써요.

quiz.q: Does the name 'Modu Bakery' ___ ? I think we ordered from them.
quiz.note: 머릿속 종이 울리는 이미지. 주로 의문문·부정문에서 씁니다.

quiz.q: The renovation will be expensive, but we'll have to ___ .
quiz.note: 마취 없던 시절 총알을 물고 수술받던 데서 온 표현이에요.
